quotes.text: For D330263 at revision 15956ae87e31, the review reported that the calendar dialog row’s visible label did not activate its toggle. A separate accessible name did not provide that click behavior. A temporary click check left the toggle unchecked, and an accessibility check warned about the visible label. Recheck the current template before applying this finding to a later revision.
